components.css: .ds-stamp-wrap{position:relative;width:180px;padding:24px;background:var(--night);font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-stamp{padding:8px;background:var(--moon);-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle 5px,#0000 98%,#000) -7px -7px/14px 14px round,linear-gradient(#000 0 0) 7px 7px/calc(100% - 14px) calc(100% - 14px) no-repeat;mask:radial-gradient(circle 5px,#0000 98%,#000) -7px -7px/14px 14px round,linear-gradient(#000 0 0) 7px 7px/calc(100% - 14px) calc(100% - 14px) no-repeat}.ds-stamp-face{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;aspect-ratio:9/10;padding:16px;background:var(--teal);color:#fff}.ds-stamp-code{font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;opacity:.9}.ds-stamp-name{font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.25}.ds-stamp-meta{font-size:.75rem;opacity:.9}.ds-postmark{position:absolute;top:4px;right:-4px;width:88px;transform:rotate(-14deg);animation:ds-postmark 520ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) 300ms both}@keyframes ds-postmark{from{opacity:0;transform:rotate(-32deg) scale(1.6);filter:blur(2px)}to{opacity:1;transform:rotate(-14deg) scale(1);filter:blur(0)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-postmark{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
Thoth is a marketplace of many bookstores, so the system is a post office at night. The ground is night indigo lit by a pale gold crescent; content sits on moon-white paper laid over it. Every store is a perforated stamp on one sheet, and the platform's verification is the circular postmark that cancels it. The metaphor is the brand's trust promise made visible: a store wears the postmark only once it has actually been approved.

The palette is fixed by the owner's Thoth illustration (night indigo, ibis teal, gold, ember, moon white) and every role is drawn from it. Density is calm: one dominant headline, one working card, generous gutters. Hierarchy comes from scale and weight within a single family, Be Vietnam Pro, chosen for full Vietnamese diacritic coverage. The world refuses the category default of a white centred login card beside a stock illustration.

Vietnamese is the default locale and English is first class; every string comes from `messages/{vi,en}.json` and every layout must hold both, including longer English labels and stacked Vietnamese diacritics.
keyCharacteristics: Night-indigo chrome (header, hero ground, footer) with moon-white working surfaces.
Gold marks the one forward action per view; teal carries links, focus and verification.
Perforated stamps, circular crescent-ink postmarks, store codes `TH-0000` in tabular figures.
One family, five weights (400 to 800), hierarchy by scale.

rules.name: The Gold Is Forward Rule
rules.body: Gold fills exactly one control per view: the action that moves the user on (sign in, create account). Secondary actions are outline or ghost; links are teal. If two gold buttons are visible, one is wrong.

rules.name: The Teal Means Trust Rule
rules.body: Links, focus and verification speak teal. Do not use the shadcn `link` button variant on light surfaces; it inherits `--primary` and would print gold text.

rules.name: The Ember Is Ink Rule
rules.body: Ember appears only as stamp colour, never as warning, error or emphasis. Errors are `destructive`.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is built from Be Vietnam Pro's size and weight alone. No second display face, no system fallback used as a display face.

rules.name: The Tabular Ledger Rule
rules.body: Store codes (`TH-0142`), verification dates (`03.2026`) and cart counts use `tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Night Is Tonal Rule
rules.body: On night surfaces, step through the night ramp instead of adding shadows. The card float is the only shadow on the night ground.

dos: Do give each view exactly one gold control, the forward action, at 44px (`size="lg"`) and full width in forms.
Do keep every interactive control at least 40px tall; icon-only toggles inside a 40px field may be 24px.
Do use teal for links (600 weight, underline on hover and focus) and teal focus rings on light surfaces; use 3px gold rings at 60% on night chrome.
Do show the postmark only on stores that are actually verified, with an `sr-only` text equivalent, and label placeholder stores as illustrative.
Do set store codes, dates and counts in tabular figures.
Do route every string through next-intl and check both VI and EN at mobile and desktop widths.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion` for every entrance animation.
donts: Don't fill more than one control with gold, or use gold for links or secondary buttons.
Don't use ember for errors, warnings or emphasis; it is stamp colour only.
Don't add shadows on night surfaces beyond the single card float; step the night ramp instead.
Don't introduce a second typeface or set display text in a system font.
Don't place a white centred card beside a stock illustration; the story column is the stamp sheet.
Don't hard-code copy in components; Vietnamese and English must both fit.
